text:
harry: Quick sync — proposal to add a new self-serve SKU: 'On-Demand Compute Credits' (pay-as-you-go GPU credits) as a low-friction entry for sporadic inference workloads. Questions: minimum purchase, expiry, rollover, and whether to allow instant self-serve or sales-assisted only.

sasha: Tech note: credits are straightforward if we treat them as JWT-backed short-lived tokens validated at the gateway. Major work is adding the purchase pipeline & wallet accounting in billing. Gateway change: ~1 sprint. Billing work: ~2 sprints.

li: Sales: self-serve is attractive for low-touch SMBs. But enterprise deals will ask for volume discounts and rollover. If we expose self-serve with a low minimum, AEs can still upsell.

nora: RevOps: recommend minimum pack = $50 to keep transaction volume manageable. Expiry: recommend 180 days; rollover only via negotiated contract. Avoid automatic rollover for GA to simplify ledger handling.

kevin: Finance: $50 minimum seems fine. For revenue recognition, prepaid credits that expire require separate liability lines; 180-day expiry reduces long-term liabilities. We should model churn impact of expiries.

rhea: Legal: must be explicit in TOS: credits expire after X days, non-refundable except for errors/fraud. For enterprise, allow negotiated addendum. I'll prepare standard copy.

ink: Design: checkout flows need clear affordances — show examples (e.g., "$50 = ~5 minutes of high-priority inference at 100 qps"). For GA keep purchase off-console (ops attach) or a hidden buy button? Self-serve requires more checkout QA.

pm-bot: Release manager: GA cut 2026-09-01. Billing migrations: 3 open PRs.

harry: Proposed GA plan: launch credits as sales-assisted purchase only (Ops/Finance handle invoices), Console shows a new 'Credits balance' meter but purchase button hidden. Defer fully self-serve purchase to M2 when billing wallet is hardened. This reduces billing risk and lets us validate demand. Thoughts?

sasha: +1. Minimizes QA surface and avoids rolling wallet changes in the GA cut. Tech scope manageable for M1: gateway check, account meter read-only, redemption API.

li: Sales ok with sales-assisted pilot but ask that we enable a simple order form AEs can trigger for customers. Also need clear pricing examples. I'll draft the playbook.

nora: Ops will support attach flow if Finance provides GL mapping. I'll document runbook and tagging.

kevin: I'll run a quick P&L for $50/$200 packs and expiration scenarios. Report due Thu.

rhea: I'll post the draft TOS snippet and enterprise clause for rollover exceptions.

ink: I'll deliver a read-only meter mock and microcopy that explains expiry & non-refundable policy (due Thu).

harry: Decision: ship On-Demand Compute Credits as sales-assisted pilot in M1 (no self-serve buy), 180-day expiry, $50 min pack, rollover only by contract. M2: self-serve purchase + auto-topup. Action items:
- sasha: implement gateway redemption + local cache + read-only meter API (due EOD)
- nora: ops runbook + attach flow spec + tag mapping (due Thu)
- li: sales playbook + pricing examples + order form template (due Fri)
- kevin: financial model (due Thu)
- rhea: legal TOS snippet + enterprise clause (due Thu)
- ink: console meter mock + microcopy (due Thu)
- harry: update roadmap + create milestone 'compute-credits-self-serve-M2'

pm-bot: Ticket created: PROD-16555 (compute-credits-pilot).

li: Quick ask — can we include a small pilot discount (10%) to early buyers? Helps close deals.

kevin: We can model an intro promo, but ops must enforce promo in invoice lines. Keep it timeboxed.

harry: Good idea, track as a promo experiment. If any team hits blockers for attach flow, flag here immediately. Thanks all :thumbsup:
